WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(orders.ordered_at AS TIMESTAMP)) AS "orders.ordered_at",
    CAST(SUM(orders.amount) AS DOUBLE) AS "a"
  FROM orders AS orders
  GROUP BY
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(orders.ordered_at AS TIMESTAMP))
), shifted_p AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(orders.ordered_at AS TIMESTAMP)) AS "ordered_at",
    CAST(SUM(orders.amount) AS DOUBLE) AS "a"
  FROM orders AS orders
  GROUP BY
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(orders.ordered_at AS TIMESTAMP))
), sjoin_p AS (
  SELECT
    base."orders.ordered_at",
    base."a",
    shifted_p."a" AS "p"
  FROM base
  LEFT JOIN shifted_p
    ON base."orders.ordered_at" - INTERVAL 1 MONTH IS NOT DISTINCT FROM shifted_p."ordered_at"
)
SELECT
  "orders.ordered_at",
  "a",
  "p"
FROM (
  SELECT
    "orders.ordered_at",
    "a",
    "p"
  FROM sjoin_p
) AS _outer
ORDER BY
  "orders.ordered_at" ASC
duckdb:window:
WITH _base AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST(orders.ordered_at AS TIMESTAMP)) AS "orders.ordered_at"
  FROM orders AS orders
  GROUP BY
    DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST(orders.ordered_at AS TIMESTAMP))
), _cm_orders__amount_sum_window_1d AS (
  SELECT
    _base."ordered_at",
    CAST(SUM(_src._w_value) AS DOUBLE) AS "w"
  FROM (
    SELECT
      DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST(orders.ordered_at AS TIMESTAMP)) AS "ordered_at"
    FROM orders AS orders
    GROUP BY
      DATE_TRUNC('DAY', CAST(orders.ordered_at AS TIMESTAMP))
  ) AS _base
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
      orders.ordered_at AS _w_time,
      orders.amount AS _w_value
    FROM orders AS orders
  ) AS _src
    ON _src._w_time >= _base."ordered_at" + INTERVAL 1 DAY - INTERVAL 1 DAY
    AND _src._w_time < _base."ordered_at" + INTERVAL 1 DAY
  GROUP BY
    _base."ordered_at"
)
SELECT
  _base."orders.ordered_at",
  _cm_orders__amount_sum_window_1d."w"
FROM _base
LEFT JOIN _cm_orders__amount_sum_window_1d
  ON _base."orders.ordered_at" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_orders__amount_sum_window_1d."ordered_at"
ORDER BY
  _base."orders.ordered_at" ASC
